title: Business Central 2025 Release Wave 2 Is Here! (v27)
summary: Microsoft released Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Release Wave 2 (version 27) with new features in Copilot and AI, sustainability tracking, Shopify integration, developer tools, and reporting. New customers are on this release immediately while existing customers receive automatic upgrades.
key_points: Copilot and AI capabilities now automate reconciliation, reporting, and document creation
Sustainability system allows emissions tracking and CSRD-compliant report generation
Shopify integration enhanced for B2B and Shopify Plus support
Developer tools include GitHub integration and improved app management
Reporting features include embedded Power BI and Excel-based analytics

quotes.text: Copilot & AI: Automate reconciliation, reporting, and document creation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows key AI-powered automation capabilities now available in the platform

quotes.text: New customers are on this release starting today. Existing customers will be upgraded automatically.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the rollout strategy and timeline for this major release
